message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/readstat && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/fuzz/fuzz_format_sav.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":8,"var":"Data/Size","code":"rt_buffer_t buffer = { .bytes = (char *)Data, .size = Size, .used = Size };","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are wrapped as the in-memory input stream for the SAV parser."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/fuzz/fuzz_format_sav.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":11,"var":"parser","code":"readstat_parser_t *parser = fuzzer_parser_init(Data, Size);","note":"The fuzz harness creates a parser configured to interpret the supplied bytes as a SAV file."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/spss/readstat_sav_read.c","function":"readstat_parse_sav","line":1619,"var":"ctx->row_limit","code":"ctx->row_limit = record_count_after_skipping;","note":"The parser accepts the file header and record counts, then prepares to iterate through every data row in the file."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/spss/readstat_sav_read.c","function":"sav_read_uncompressed_data","line":818,"var":"buffer_len","code":"size_t buffer_len = ctx->var_offset * 8;","note":"The row reader sizes each raw row buffer from the attacker-controlled variable layout parsed from the file metadata."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/spss/readstat_sav_read.c","function":"sav_read_uncompressed_data","line":830,"var":"buffer","code":"bytes_read = io->read(buffer, buffer_len, io->io_ctx)","note":"A full row of raw 8-byte cells is read from the crafted input into the temporary row buffer."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/spss/readstat_sav_read.c","function":"sav_process_row","line":717,"var":"ctx->raw_string","code":"ctx->raw_string[raw_str_used++] = c;","note":"String segments from the row are accumulated into the raw string buffer, preserving attacker-controlled bytes for later conversion."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/spss/readstat_sav_read.c","function":"sav_process_row","line":727,"var":"ctx->utf8_string","code":"retval = readstat_convert(ctx->utf8_string, ctx->utf8_string_len, ctx->raw_string, raw_str_used, ctx->converter);","note":"When the last segment of a logical string is reached, the accumulated bytes are converted into the UTF-8 output buffer."},
{"step":8,"file":"src/readstat_convert.c","function":"readstat_convert","line":27,"var":"dst/src","code":"memcpy(dst, src, src_len);","note":"With no iconv converter active, the function copies the attacker-controlled string bytes directly into the destination buffer after only a length check."},
{"step":9,"file":"src/spss/readstat_sav_read.c","function":"sav_process_row","line":731,"var":"ctx->handle.value","code":"ctx->handle.value(ctx->current_row, ctx->variables[var_info->index], value, ctx->user_ctx)","note":"The converted string is handed to the value callback, which triggers the downstream readstat_convert heap-buffer-overflow READ in the vulnerable target state."}
]
path=pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
path.write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(path)
PY
bash submit.sh /workspace/candidate_trace.json /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true
